record.label: Coordinate copying and X-basis measurement uncomputation
record.statement: The walk step copies selected particle coordinates into ancillas and clears the copies with mid-circuit Pauli-$X$ measurements and classically controlled $CZ$ corrections.
record.boundary: Suppose an ancilla holds the bit $f(x)$. Measuring it in the $X$ basis gives the phase $(-1)^{mf(x)}$ for outcome $m$. If $f$ is a parity of pairwise products, applying a $CZ$ for each product when $m=1$ cancels the phase. The one-ancilla lemma assumes this form of $f$ and that the ancilla started in zero. The full routing budget includes copying the coordinates and all the operations needed to clear them.
